title: B+ tree leaf node split deadlock under multi-threaded concurrent readers
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0572: B+ tree leaf node split deadlock under multi-threaded concurrent readers
Repository: `tikv/tikv`
Category: `Storage Engine Crash Consistency & WAL`
Target File: `storage/btree/page.cpp`

#### Problem Description
Right-sibling pointer update violates latch acquisition hierarchy when concurrent traversal scans backward.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Acquire sibling latches in strict ascending key order and release parent latch immediately upon split.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0572.py -q`
expected_invariant: Acquire sibling latches in strict ascending key order and release parent latch immediately upon split.
